scope.why_new_scope: The old exact-boundary node solve had original flow .25009, ruling 8.9625e9 and true moment-history defect .18717. Replace independent history coordinates by the actual curve integrals proved in R609; do not extend that old solve.
scope.h_k_model: h=1.9+tanh(sum a_j cos(j*pi*x)); k=1.95*tanh(sum b_j sin((2*j+1)*pi*x/2)); physical s=L*x.
scope.true_history_definition: eta integral from zero; all eight A integrate original M, four odd centers are negative total integrals; all six rho integrate the original C2 coefficients on both sides. No independent history nodes.
scope.four_even_constraints: R609 (9): p1/L, (8*t1+2*p1)/L, 8*H^2*r1/L, 4*H^2*s0/L. Exact invertible row transform, none omitted.
scope.center_gauge: zeta0 is R609 (17), with all H/v/Ac/a0 derivatives; only zeta1/zeta2 remain two globally constant controls.
scope.jacobian: Full forward parameter chain through shape jets, L, eta, eight true histories, dependent center, both coefficient evaluations, six rho, complete factored positive potential and all gauge pairings.
scope.integration: Eight panels, sixteen-point positive Gauss each, plus two observation endpoints. Same Legendre prefix integration operator for eta/A/rho; finite quadrature is not an exact integral certificate.
scope.step: Actual four-end SVD tangent direction with damped GN. Every trial restores only the actual curve through true endpoint integration; all end rows <=1e-9 and actual sampled box, plus strict complete-ruling RMS decrease, required for acceptance.
scope.global_gauge: One two-column global LS per actual curve. Same initial actual-ruling-based unit frozen across all mode and grid levels. No point-dependent gauges.
scope.actual_scope_bounds: Each function coefficient in [-6,6], physical L in [2.1,7.9], finite gauge coordinates <=1e6; sampled eta<.999 and gamma/upsilon<5.99. Only h/k bounds have continuous guarantees at this stage.
scope.refinement: At final same curve and L, same free gauges and same unit, rebuild all histories on 16x16+2 nodes. Dependent centers/zeta0 are recomputed by definition, no free-gauge refit. Print original residuals coarse and fine.
scope.physical_readout: Original same-curve frame/position, both collar edges, first variations, sampled focal cap/diameter and both pose conditions; original nu/nuhat, terminal sigma/Tproj and reanchored gauge. No continuous reach or finite-flex claim.
scope.necessary_rebuilding: Same R598 coefficient table and positive Gram must be regenerated because raw tables were not stored; costs counted. No old identity, derivative, quadrature comparison, guide or optimizer gate replay.
scope.local_checks: Paper/source/AST/JSON/hash only; no numerical or symbolic execution.
